collection.title: VW Taigo 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The VW Taigo 2021 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Qashqai, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: VW Taigo 2021 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
